programme.title: Victim(s) / 加害者、被害者
programme.desc: A ruthless Kuala Lumpur high school student kills his classmate, exposing the contrasting struggles of the victim's mother and the murderer's mother as they uncover their sons' hidden secrets, while inching closer to a heartbreaking truth.

programme.title: Guilt By Design / 催眠·裁決
programme.desc: On the final day of a shocking murder trial in Hong Kong, a renowned hypnotherapist serving as a juror receives a video showing his daughter being kidnapped. programme.title: Break Up Club / 分手說愛你
programme.desc: Joe is a 20-something slacker who only takes one thing seriously: his on-and-off girlfriend Flora. However, despite the efficiency of the website, Joe's refusal to change his immature ways and Flora's attraction to a talented graffiti artist threatens to break them up once more.

programme.title: Endless Battle / 無間一戰
programme.desc: This is a story about two brothers. The younger brother is a drug lord while the elder brother Zhong is a police officer in the Narcotics Bureau. programme.title: Little Red Sweet / 紅豆
programme.desc: A Chinese dessert shop owned by the Chang family in Kowloon City faces upheaval when the mother suffers a devastating stroke. Can they find a way to overcome their struggles and remain united?

programme.title: Last Suspect / 拯救嫌疑人
programme.desc: Lawyer Chen receives a mysterious call demanding her to defend a murder suspect after her daughter is kidnapped, and is told that she can only save her daughter by winning the case. programme.title: Burning Blood / 熱血燃燒

However, despite the efficiency of the website, Joe's refusal to change his immature ways and Flora's attraction to a talented graffiti artist threatens to break them up once more.

programme.title: Endless Battle / 無間一戰
programme.desc: This is a story about two brothers. The younger brother is a drug lord while the elder brother Zhong is a police officer in the Narcotics Bureau. Both are involved in a drug cartel’s turf battle and during an escort mission, Zhong discovers his brother’s hidden identity. This leads to an endless battle between good and evil.

programme.title: Little Red Sweet / 紅豆
programme.desc: A Chinese dessert shop owned by the Chang family in Kowloon City faces upheaval when the mother suffers a devastating stroke. Their daughter sacrifices her dream of becoming a flight attendant to help keep the family business alive, but tensions rise as she clashes with her father. Can they find a way to overcome their struggles and remain united?

programme.title: Last Suspect / 拯救嫌疑人
programme.desc: Lawyer Chen receives a mysterious call demanding her to defend a murder suspect after her daughter is kidnapped, and is told that she can only save her daughter by winning the case. As she starts investigation with the police and evidence emerges, Chen discovers the truth and reveals the mastermind. Can she rescue her daughter in time?

programme.title: Burning Blood / 熱血燃燒
programme.desc: After a corrupt cop leaks their operation, four elite narcotics officers are ambushed while pursuing a cross-border drug lord. One is killed, their leader dies in the line of duty, and another vanishes without a trace. Years later, the surviving Chan Tai Wah and Low Mai reunite to expose the long-hidden mole and avenge their fallen comrades.

programme.title: Dead To Rights / 南京照相館
programme.desc: During the 1937 Nanjing Massacre, civilians hiding in Ji Xiang Studio are forced to develop film for the Japanese army, only to uncover photographic evidence of its atrocities. Risking execution if discovered, they decide to preserve the negatives and expose the truth, determined to reveal the horrors of the massacre to the world.

programme.title: New Kung Fu Cult Master 2 / 倚天屠龍記之聖火雄風
programme.desc: In this sequel, Zhang Wu Ji successfully rescued the Six Major sects at Dadu. Nevertheless, the quest for the Dragon Sabre continues as Wu Ji and his three girlfriends set sail for Ice Fire Island. After a series of vicious fights, they finally unveil the secret behind the Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre.

programme.title: Kill Time / 謀殺似水年華
programme.desc: Mak stumbles upon an obscure website “Witch’s Zone” when looking for a copy of her dead father’s favorite song. The mysterious website only allows one purchase but Mak cannot resist buying one more purple scarf. Not only does the scarf triggers her memories of her father and her first love, it may also be a vital clue in a mysterious murder.

programme.title: Back to the Past / 尋秦記
programme.desc: After helping Ying Zheng unite China, Hong Siu Lung lives in seclusion for 20 years. However, peace is shattered when a group of time travellers returns with modern weapons to seize the Qin throne. Forced to reunite after decades apart, Hong Siu Lung and Ying Zheng must fight to defend the Qin dynasty and protect the fate of history itself.

programme.title: Chosen One, The / 流氓驅魔師
programme.desc: Ah Jie resists using his paranormal powers, but when renowned paranormal vlogger Sora triggers a series of mysterious events, he must embrace his destiny as the "Chosen One" to save lives.

programme.title: Life Hotel / 來福大酒店
programme.desc: Once a gangster, Li struggles to find work to pay for his father’s heart surgery. To earn money, he goes undercover to help shut down Life Hotel for a redevelopment project, but gradually forms bonds with its residents. As Li discovers that the hotel serves as a home for the sick, he grapples with his sense of responsibility and empathy.
